description: This file defines a validator class PasswordPreferencesDataValidator for validating JSON input related to password preferences. It processes the JSON to ensure it contains supported parameters and that the provided validation policy ID is present and greater than zero before proceeding with further logic or update operations.

classes.name: PasswordPreferencesDataValidator
classes.description: A Spring component class responsible for validating JSON data related to password preferences. It ensures the data contains supported parameters and enforces constraints such as validity of the policy ID.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the provided JSON string for updating password preferences, checking for unsupported parameters and that the validation policy ID is present and greater than zero.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws a data validation exception if there are any validation errors collected during the validation process.
